name: VoxelMesher::build_mesh
definition: Constructs a Godot ArrayMesh from voxel buffer data, handling material assignment, surface assembly, and optional Transvoxel detail normal map generation.
summary: VoxelMesher::build_mesh constructs Godot ArrayMesh objects from voxel data, distinguishing itself by handling material assignment and final assembly rather than raw vertex generation or region culling.
